༄༅/ /dpal sngags kyi srung ma'i rjes gnang dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sngags kyi srung ma'i rjes gnang dngos grub

rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin bzhugs/ hūm̐ 'grub par gyur cig /dpal gdod ma'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal ldan mi pham ral gcig ma'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i de bzhin nyid mngon du byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa lta ba'i rgyab dang ldan pas/ dben par rak+ta dang bdud rtsis chag chag btab la/ chos 'byung gru gsum pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad me ris bskor ba'i dbus su/ khri'u'i khar dpal gtor gru gsum pa 'khor lnga/ dkar rgyan dmar rgyan sman raka bran pa la mda' dar mthing nag tsakli dang bcas pa gzug /mdun du sman raka gtor ma/ bum pa/ mtha' skor du tshogs dang spyan gzigs sna tshogs bag dro bar bshams la/ rang nyid sa ma dhis bskor ba'i cho ga sngags sgrub tshogs yan grub par bya zhing*/ slob bu la skong bshags yig brgya bzla bcug la/ de nas slob bu las ldan gsum las mi mang ba la khrus bya/ gu gul bdug /bgegs bskrad/ gdan la 'khod cing phyag byas te/ bla ma kun tu bzang po dngos su bsam zhing*/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ hoḥ bla ma kun bzang he ru ka /rang bzhin dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ /bdag la dpal ldan khros ma yi/ /rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ bla mas bdud rtsi blud de/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod skal ba bzang*/ /gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /sems can ma lus 'dul slad du/ /nag mo khros ma'i gnang ba sbyin/ /dam bsrung bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thung*/ /ma hā su khaṃ/ de nas slob bu rnams gnas o rgyan sprul pa'i grong khyer phyi rol du dur khrod chen pos yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad chos 'byung dang bcas par/ skad cig gis dbyings kyi kun tu bzang mor bskyed pa'i thugs kar dga' ba 'khyil ba/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dga' ba 'khyil ba 'khor bas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas o rgyan bsil ba'i tshal nas/ dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma sku mdog smug

/zhal gcig phyag gnyis nu ma 'phyang*/ ral pa gcig gtibs dpral na spyan gcig zhal na tshems gcig khro rngams 'jigs pa/ me rlung 'tshubs ma khrag gi mtsho 'khyil/ phyag g.yas tsit+ta zhal du gsol zhing*/ g.yon pas zhing dbyug klad la bskor zhing*/ 'khor du dbyings kyi ma mo lnga nyid dang*/ las byed ma mo 'bum gyis bskor zhing*/ dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur byon par bsam/ de nas gu gul tshil chen pad raka gi du bas bdug cing ḍa dril sogs rol mo'i sgras/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin dbyings kyi gnas mchog nas/ /dpal ldan nag mo khros ma ni/ /e ka dza ṭī dbyings kyi yum/ /mched kyi ma mo sprul 'khor bcas/ /sku mdog smug nag tse re re/ /dgyes pa'i zhal bgrad ya la la/ /dngos grub char 'bebs si li li/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /bdag dang mos pa'i bu rnams la/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs tshe dbang stsol/ /las bzhi phrin las grub pa dang*/ /bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol/ / oṃ ma ma e ka dza ṭī trag rak+ṣa ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes bstim/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras byin phab la/ bla ma'i dpral ba las 'od 'phros/ sku'i ma mo grangs med spyan drangs/ slob bu'i dpral bar bstim/ gtor ma gong gi mngon rtogs bzhin bsgom/ spyi bor bzung*/ hūm̐ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / phrin las sgrub mdzad sku yi lha/ /sku yi ma mos byin gyis rlobs/ /sku yi dbang bskur chen po sbyin// sngags sham du kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ gtor ma gnas so so bzung de bzhin du gsung las 'od zer 'phros/ gsung gi ma mo/ slob ma'i ngag /hūm̐ zhes sogs/ gsung gi ma mo sogs/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ thugs kyi/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nas g.yas su snying*/ g.yon du zhing dbyug /mdun du thod khrag sgrub dpe gtad de/ gtor ma spyi bor bzung*/ slob dpon che ba'i nga rgyal gzi brjid dang bcas pas/

hūm̐ bh+yo/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /sngags kyi srung mas byin gyis rlobs/ /dngos grub ma lus dus 'dir thob/ /phrin las rnam pa bzhi yis ni/ /gsang sngags bstan srungs dam chos skyongs/ khyod kyis 'gro ba 'dul bar brtson/ /de bzhin ma mo 'khor bcas kyis/ /dad ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /gong gi sngags sham du/ kā ya wāk tsit+ta ā yu pu ṇ+ye ba su pu tra sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐/ shā trūn sarba shān+tiṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ lha 'dre mi gsum bā shaṃ ku ru mchog thun mong puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ dpal sngags kyi srung ma 'khor dang bcas pas dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i tshogs gtor rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sngon gyi thugs dam bzhin du rdo rje'i slob bu che ge mo la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs sogs/ slob bu'i rgyud tshod/ 'gro don nus mi nus/ mchog /phal pa/ nad pa/ gdon can/ bu nor 'dod sogs 'don pa bsgyur la/ gtor ma byin rlabs/ 'dod gsol/ bcol dam/ gnyer gtad/ bka' gtad/ rjes su gnang ba/ bka' 'grol sogs rigs brtags la rgyas par bya'o/ / de nas tshogs la rol/ dpal gtor dngos grub tu longs spyod/ mchod bstod gshegs gsol skabs dang sbyar/ dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ nad gdon mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs zhi nas/ dpal ldan nag mos bu bzhin legs bskyangs te/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /ces bsngo ba smon lam shis pa rgya cher brjod par bya'o/ /tshul 'di rig 'dzin pad+ma'i gsung ji ltar/ /de yi thugs kyi 'od zer phog pa yi/ / rdzogs chen rnal 'byor klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen mgul du bkod/ /sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) dpal sngags kyi srung ma'i rjes gnang*/ - PAGE 210 -- PAGE 211 -- PAGE 209 -
